regression_purpose: Canonical mis-classification exemplar from manuals/_E2-SUBTYPE-TAXONOMY.md §11. The SharePoint folder label '(BUS)' is NOT a reliable Subtype 1 indicator. Cemre's case was BUS-labeled but doctrinally Subtype 3 (corporate parent = principal treaty investor; Beneficiary = executive employee). USCIS RFE'd on classification ambiguity; firm corrected to Subtype 3 in vol2 cover letter and was approved.

enterprise.claimed_business_model: International construction trade and project sourcing

ownership_history.note: Foreign treaty-country parent is the principal treaty investor; Beneficiary is an executive employee, not the personal investor.

source_of_funds.note: Wire from Turkish parent corporation to US subsidiary; no personal SOF chain present.

rfes.initial_filing_assertion: Beneficiary classified as primary treaty investor (Subtype 1) in initial cover letter.
rfes.response_assertion: Vol2 cover letter corrects classification: Beneficiary is an executive employee of the corporate-parent treaty investor (Subtype 3). Approved post-correction.
Documented $36,000; investment-amount inconsistency disclosed and reconciled with audited corporate financials of the foreign parent.

raw_doc_signals_present: Foreign corporate Articles of Incorporation for Musluoglu Holdings A.S. (Turkish parent)
Audited financials for the Turkish parent corporation
Board resolution authorizing the parent's investment in the US subsidiary
Beneficiary CV titled at executive level (Director / GM at the Turkish parent)
NO Membership Interest Transfer Agreement granting personal ownership to Beneficiary
NO personal source-of-funds chain (no Tapu / personal bank statements / personal currency conversion)
raw_doc_signals_absent_for_subtype_1: No personal foreign-bank statements documenting investor's own savings
No Membership Interest Transfer Agreement naming Beneficiary as a >=50% personal member
